decision.observation: Back to 0 mph after a second full 1.0s hold, nose against the pine trunk, all dots dark. The puddled tarmac runs diagonally down-right of the car, only a couple of car widths away.
decision.hypothesis: This is a confirmed nose pin: two throttle holds failed to move it. Reverse must first actually engage, so a plain S hold (no steering) is the reliable way to break free.
decision.memory: Plain S reverses more reliably than S+steer here, which twice ended at 0 mph with gear R; check for real backwards motion before steering.
